title: Adonis 5 day split
author: Adin A.
desc:
Adjust it as per your gym requirements. Better to alternate the exercise between machines, dumbbells, barbells, and cables.
Do the warm up properly and do 1 or 2 warm up sets then go 1 heavy sets that's it 
You better do it within an hour if you do only 1 or 2 sets 
And get proper rest between workouts and don't take too much rest between warm up set

ex.note: Do the last set as a dead drop set. Start from 2.5kg and add 2.5kg for each 10 reps all the way to your strength reach the limit and come all the way down as well again to 2.5kg
